<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915617_theRebbe_822" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915617_theRebbe_822__p009">
  <section v="24">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the blessing "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is actually a request for miracles in the present, and just as the blessing for forgiveness removes doubt, so too this blessing assures that miracles will occur now.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And it is explained in the maamar</t>
    <t s="3">(at its conclusion and seal)</t>
    <t s="4">that what is said "Blessed is He who performed miracles... in this time" is a request that there should be miracles also in this time.</t>
    <t s="5">And according to what the Alter Rebbe said</t>
    <t s="6">(the master of the joy and redemption of 19 Kislev)</t>
    <t s="7">in Tanya45</t>
    <t s="8">regarding the request "Forgive us,"</t>
    <t s="9">that since we bless</t>
    <t s="10">(after the request)</t>
    <t s="11">"Blessed are You, Hashem, the gracious One who abundantly forgives,"</t>
    <t s="12">there is no doubt about this — it is understood,</t>
    <t s="13">that likewise it is regarding the request that the Holy One, blessed be He, perform miracles also in this time,</t>
    <t s="14">that since we bless "Blessed... who performed miracles... in this time,"</t>
    <t s="15">there is no doubt,</t>
    <t s="16">that in this time,</t>
    <t s="17">in the imminent future,</t>
    <t s="18">the Holy One, blessed be He, will perform miracles (in the plural),</t>
    <t s="19">all four types mentioned above,</t>
    <t s="20">including also the miracles of "We will show him wonders"46</t>
    <t s="21">that will be at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one — that also these miracles will be in this time,</t>
    <t s="22">in the truly imminent future,</t>
    <t s="23">at the coming of Mashiach our righteous one, speedily in our days, literally.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
